panel_id.description: Positive panel ID returned by gpu_arena_describe (identifier, not a count).

start.description: Absolute time as Unix seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (number or numeric string; fractional seconds allowed), or a timezone-qualified RFC3339 string, e.g. 2026-11-03T08:00:00+08:00. Numeric values are seconds, not milliseconds. Defaults to seven days before end.

end.description: Absolute time as Unix seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (number or numeric string; fractional seconds allowed), or a timezone-qualified RFC3339 string, e.g. 2026-11-03T08:00:00+08:00. Numeric values are seconds, not milliseconds. Defaults to now; window must be positive and at most 90 days.

step.description: Range-query sampling interval in seconds (s), at least 1; for example 60 samples once per minute. At most 11000 samples per series. Defaults to max(30, ceil(window_seconds / 1000)).
